HolidayArcherGamepass.png|Default skin on the Holiday Archer [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The first version of the {{Color|Deluxe|Huntsman}} skin was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/96554028/profile/ impjelly]. *The first version of the Default skin wore the [[w:c:r2da:Christmas Beanie|Christmas Beanie]] and [[w:c:r2da:Christmas Coat|Christmas Coat]] from ''R2DA'' at Level 5. *Oddly, some renders depicted the Default '''Holiday Archer''' with an eyepatch, when it is not present on the actual tower. **This is because the original model actually had an eyepatch, though this part of the design was cut before release. *When the Overhaul Update was released, no skins were successfully carried over from the previous version of the game. **This was fixed on the 23rd of November 2020. *The '''Archer''' used to share its Level 3 icon with the [[Gladiator]]'s Level 2 icon. *The {{Color|Premium|Ninja}} skin was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/35741128/profile Tixlord]. *The '''Archer's''' Level 5 upgrade icon used to be a sword, despite the '''Archer''' not having a sword or a melee attack at all. **This is because the '''Archer's''' Level 5 upgrade name used to be called ''Sword Arrows'', which is why the icon used a sword. Despite this, the arrows for the '''Archer''' did not change into sword arrows. *The first version of the {{Color|Valentine|Valentines}} skin was based on 7ess' concept art of it, the latter being a friend of [https://www.roblox.com/users/85018312/profile/ MRhello]. **The original name of the concept art skin was called the Love Messenger. *The {{Color|Christmas2025|Elf}} skin is based on the first version of the Default skin. *The {{Color|Christmas2025|Ice Soul}} is a submission made by linxthedeveloper. **This skin was first submitted in 2023, before getting added during the [[The Final Act Event]] in the [[Christmas 2025 Crate]]. ===Roblox Catalog=== *The first version of the {{Color|Deluxe|Huntsman}} skin used a hat similar to the {{RLinkC|69343972|Bear Hunter}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The first version of the Default skin used a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|1235487|Elf Hat}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The headband used by the {{Color|Premium|Ninja}} skin was the {{RLinkC|11297708|Black Ninja Headband of the Silent Sun}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The sword on the Level 5 upgrade icon is the {{RLinkC|20721924|Spartan Sword}} gear from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== ''This only refers to cosmetic changes to the [[Archer]].
